question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Arrogant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Arrogant"** means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. (अहंकारी)

 
 
• **Example: **His **arrogant** attitude made him unpopular among his peers.
 
 
 
• **"Modest" **refers to someone who is unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite his great success, he remained a** modest** man.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'arrogant' **is **'modest'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uppity **(अहंकारी): Self-important; arrogant.

 
 
• **Example:** She has become quite uppity since she got promoted.
 
 
 
• **Assemble **(इकट्ठा करना): Gather together in one place for a common purpose.
 
 
• **Example: **The students were asked to assemble in the auditorium for the lecture.
 
 
 
• **Unreserved** (खुला हुआ): Not restricted; frank and open.
 
 
• **Example:** He was unreserved in his praise for the team.
